response.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) as avg_wins, AVG(CASE WHEN l IS NOT NULL AND l > 0 AND g IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / l ELSE NULL END) as avg_g_minus_l_over_l FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_stats.team_id, team_stats.avg_wins, team_stats.avg_g_minus_l_over_l, team_stats.avg_wins - overall_stats.mean_wins as gap FROM team_stats CROSS JOIN overall_stats WHERE team_stats.avg_wins > overall_stats.mean_wins ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10
